scope: Checked exact rational top-level linear systems over the complete sparse affine engine.
public_commit: This containing commit publishes the bridge, helper, dispatch and regression selection.

implemented.mathematics: Reuses the independently checked complete single-RHS affine family. Native rendering selects the original supplied free coordinates by the verified free-column indices.
implemented.matrix_forms: Accepts the four built-in mutable/immutable dense/sparse classes. Exact sparse pair and augmented forms do not materialize a dense coefficient or augmented matrix; row-vector RHS adaptation uses captured native sparse transpose.
implemented.identity: Preserves original Symbol/Dummy free-coordinate objects and full native assumption identities. Reconstructed Dummies retain the supplied caller object locally while an existing registry owner remains unchanged and independently validated. Automatic parameters follow the verified free-column order.
implemented.outputs: linsolve publishes a typed FiniteSet containing one symbolic Tuple, or EmptySet for inconsistency. solve_linear_system publishes only verified pivot assignments, an empty dict for no constraints, or None for inconsistency.
implemented.admission: Checks both original matrix sources, all supplied coordinates, exact native interfaces, scalar/result interfaces, assumptions, source storage and parameter owners around solving and publication.
implemented.publication: Uses the native affine grammar plus captured original storage descriptors; no Python scalar arithmetic, printed-string reparsing or replaceable constructor builds an accepted exact family.
implemented.fallback: Existing symbolic-coefficient behavior is selected only when exact rational admission declines before native entry. Native errors remain terminal. Equation-list coefficient extraction retains its previous implementation.
